messages:
Priya: Morning — grabbing the Friday 09:30 PT release slot for webapp + model-v2 canary. Plan: 09:30 deploy to canary (10% traffic), 09:45 smoke, 10:00 ramp to 50% if green. Need a smoke owner and a rollback-ready ack.
Dylan: heads up — this includes tokenizer update? Any migration steps?
Priya: yes, minor tokenizer change. DB schema untouched. migration id: none. tokenizer ship note in PR #4821. No blocking long ops.
Maria: I can own smoke at 09:45. Will run the standard smoke checklist and health probes. :white_check_mark:
Ben: I'll stand by for rollback. What's the rollback command for the routing/traffic switch?
Priya: rollback is simple, route back to model-v1 via the traffic manager. Quick command:
```bash
redwood traffic switch --service webapp --from model-v2-canary --to model-v1 --confirm
```
Priya: smoke checklist (short):
- hit /health and /predict on canary
- compare latency P50/P95 vs baseline
- run canary prompt set (links inside)
- verify billing tags
deploy-bot: Slot reserved by Priya for 2026-04-03 09:30 PT. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rcv-2026-canary
Dylan: thanks — I'll watch metrics and keep an eye on KV cache warm-up.
Maria: noted. I'll post quick pass/fail in this thread after smoke. If anything odd, I'll escalate to rollback.
Ben: :thumbsup: I'll be reachable on pager in case we need to flip traffic. Added the rollback command to the PR description.
Priya: perfect. small request — whoever merges, please add the tag `release:2026-04-03-canary` so we can search traces.
Dylan: merging ~09:10 PT, will not self-merge until preflight passes.
Maria: preflight checklist done 09:15 — small sanity checks green. Ready.
Priya: thanks — see you in the slot. I'll post the final go/no-go at 09:25.
(automated) deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: 09:20 PT — run smoke preflight.
Priya: go/no-go: GO. Maria, you have the smoke.
Maria: smoke PASS at 09:47. Latency slightly higher by 5% p95 but within runway. No errors. Recommend ramp to 50%.
Ben: rolling to 50% now.
Dylan: observed stable traces. KV hit-rate improving.
Priya: ramp to 100% at 10:05 if no regressions. Documenting final step here.
Maria: will monitor for 20 more mins.
Priya: thanks all. Closing thread after final verification. :tada:
